units.source_text: 这天晚上，我和柏木彼此谈了些什么，已经记不太清楚了。

en.t: I can no longer remember very clearly what Kashiwagi and I talked about with each other that evening.

units.source_text: 我想大概也不会谈什么了不起的内容吧。

en.t: I suppose we probably did not talk about anything particularly important.

units.source_text: 首先，柏木丝毫无意谈到他平索挂在嘴边的奇特的哲学和带毒的反论。

en.t: To begin with, Kashiwagi had not the slightest intention of speaking about the strange philosophy and venomous objections he usually kept on his lips.
